channel.title: Campus Evidence Lab Briefs
channel.description: Public-source research briefs from Campus Evidence Lab.

item.title: Broader Civil Rights Scope Seed
item.description: Campus Evidence Lab added source-backed records extending the MVP beyond shared-ancestry and Title IX examples into anti-Black racial harassment and race/national-origin program access records.

item.title: Department of Education 60-University Letter Import
item.description: Campus Evidence Lab imported a public-source batch from the Department of Education's March 10, 2025 OCR letter announcement listing 60 institutions under investigation or monitoring for antisemitic discrimination and harassment concerns.

item.title: OCR Higher-Education Public Record Import
item.description: Campus Evidence Lab imported a public-source batch of OCR higher-education civil-rights records from the Department of Education's What's New in OCR page.

item.title: Seed Dataset Note
item.description: Campus Evidence Lab initialized its first public-source dataset scaffold with OCR, federal investigation, and institutional-response records for interface and workflow validation.
